text: Cucumber (ត្រសក់, part of the Cucurbit family) is grown commercially in Kaoh Kong province's Thmar Bang, Botum Sakor and Kompong Seila districts under the STEER project (Save the Children / iDE, Nov 2019 manual). Seed should be selected for suitability to local market demand, a known/traceable production date and expiry, disease resistance, high yield potential, and good shelf life. Recommended seed weight reference: roughly 350-400 seeds per 10g packet, or 3,000-4,000 seeds per 100g for larger commercial lots; fruit shape/yield varies by variety and by season/region of planting.
